headline: FOMC 2:00pm, hike odds 93%, 10y 5.00% highest close since 2007, S&P futures +0.2%
stance: Equity futures are higher ahead of the first Fed hike since 2023. Powell at 2:30 matters more than the decision at 2:00.

news.head: Futures higher into decision day
news.body: Dow futures +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.2%, Nasdaq-100 +0.4% (~6am ET). Equities are pricing the decision as done and the guidance as benign.

news.head: Tens closed at a 2007 high Tuesday
news.body: 10y settled 5.00%, its highest close since 2007. It traded above 5.04% intraday and closed below that level.

news.head: WTI slips overnight, pipeline still shut
news.body: WTI $104.68 overnight (~6am ET), below Tuesday's close. Riyadh has given no restart date for the East-West line.

implications: Financial conditions tightened without the Fed. A 25bp move ratifies what the long end and the oil price already did.
Equity futures are higher into a meeting that could deliver a hawkish 2027 path. That is the asymmetry into 2:30.

watch.head: Retail sales, 8:30
watch.body: August advance sales, the last hard data before 2:00pm. July fell 0.6% month-on-month.

watch.head: FOMC decision, 2:00pm
watch.body: Statement and the quarterly projections at 2:00, Powell at 2:30. The 2027 median is the number that moves the curve.

watch.head: Foreign Treasury flows, 4:00pm
watch.body: Cross-border buying of US securities. The first read on foreign demand since the long end broke 5%.

watch.head: Bank of England, Thursday 7:00am
watch.body: Rate decision with the MPC vote split. The Bank of Japan follows overnight into Friday.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Tens gave back the 5.04% intraday print and still closed at a 2007 high. The selloff is losing pace, not direction.
25bp today takes the funds range to 3.75-4.00%, the first increase since July 2023.
Futures priced 4.2% by December and 4.6% by September 2027 at Monday's close. The dots have to match that.
sections.positioning: 5y Treasury specs jumped 12 points to the 88th percentile this week, a new extended long. 2y specs sit at 98, unchanged for seven weeks.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Only 34% of S&P 500 names hold their 50-day and 28% of Nasdaq-100 names. The index is higher; the median stock is not.
Half the S&P 500 still holds its 200-day. This is a leadership problem, not a trend break.
sections.positioning: VIX specs sit at the 4th percentile, a fifth week extended short. They slipped another 5 points this week, into a policy event.

single_name.note: Angel Studios: three insider buys filed Monday, holds its 200-day, 3.4 days to cover. Fourth session on the scan.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Funding shows no stress into the first hike in three years. Overnight rates trade through OIS, not above it.
Equity-credit correlation is 0.60. Spreads are not an independent read on the macro right now.
Investment grade and high yield are both marked to Monday, before the 5% close. The repricing question is still open.

ideas.line: 5 open · 1 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
